description: List recent time entries, optionally filtered by project and/or date range. Returns at most 50 entries by default; pass a higher `limit` to see more.

endDate.description: ISO-8601 — only entries whose start time is on or before this.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return. Defaults to 50.

project.description: Optional project id or exact name. Omit to list across all projects.

startDate.description: ISO-8601 — only entries whose start time is on or after this.

name: list_entries
